cover.coreProposition: 持久化智能体应把长期记忆表示为带来源、权限与时间边界的显式承诺，分别保存观察内容、生命周期分类、写入路径与读取权限，并把提升和撤销记录为可审计转换。
cover.visualMetaphor: A cyan memory capsule rests in a layered archive while amber transition markers trace promotion and revision across time.
cover.semanticObject: A cyan memory capsule rests in a layered archive while amber transition markers trace promotion and revision across time.
cover.compositionIntent: Landscape editorial cover with restrained layered geometry, a clear central memory form, strong thumbnail hierarchy and generous negative space
